policy_set: Egypt Private Sector Leave (Law 14 of 2025 — simplified ruleset)
source: Condensed from public summaries of Egypt Labor Law 14/2025; internal automation only.

policies.message: Annual leave is not granted before completing 6 months of service (first entitlement is up to 15 paid days after that milestone).

policies.condition: leave_type == 'annual' and employment_duration_months >= 6 and employment_duration_months < 12 and days_requested <= 15
policies.message: After 6 months but before one full year, up to 15 paid annual leave days may be granted under the simplified schedule.

policies.condition: leave_type == 'annual' and employment_duration_months >= 6 and employment_duration_months < 12 and days_requested > 15
policies.message: In the first year of service (from month 6 to before month 12), annual leave cannot exceed 15 paid days under this simplified rule.

policies.condition: leave_type == 'annual' and employment_duration_months >= 12 and employment_duration_months < 120 and days_requested <= 21
policies.message: After one full year of service and before 10 years, up to 21 paid annual leave days per year may be granted under the simplified schedule.

policies.condition: leave_type == 'annual' and employment_duration_months >= 12 and employment_duration_months < 120 and days_requested > 21
policies.message: Before completing 10 years of service, annual leave cannot exceed 21 paid days per year under this simplified rule.
After 10 years of service (or equivalent long tenure in this model), up to 30 paid annual leave days may be granted (aligned with the long-service tier in summaries of Law 14/2025).
Even after 10 years of service, this workflow caps a single annual leave request at 30 paid days (disability-related longer entitlements are not modeled here).
Sick leave depends on a competent medical authority and pay bands over up to 12 months in a 3-year cycle; HR or medical review is required.
Maternity leave of up to 120 paid days is within the statutory entitlement described for Law 14/2025 in public summaries.
A single maternity leave request cannot exceed 120 paid days under the summarized statutory cap.
Hajj leave is granted only once after at least 5 years (60 months) of continuous service.
After 5 years of service, Hajj leave of up to one month (30 days) may be granted under the summarized rules.
Hajj leave cannot exceed one month (30 days) at a time in this simplified model.
Short personal or special-circumstance leave (mapped to casual in this schema) up to 3 days may be auto-approved when other rules do not block it.
More than 3 consecutive days for this informal short-leave category must go through HR under special-circumstances procedures.
Contact leave after exposure to contagious disease requires a medical decision and HR approval (up to 3 months may be possible under law summaries).
Unpaid leave requires explicit employer approval under Law 14/2025 summaries.
